text:
maria: Quick sync — CloudLoom marketplace listing + integration blog + joint webinar. Need a tight launch choreography and inbound routing plan. Who can own which pieces? :spiral_calendar:
jasper: I can own partner comms and the marketplace listing requirements. Partner asked for co-branded hero and a short demo video (60s). Can we commit to assets by next Tue?
sara: I’ll write the integration blog and draft the webinar outline. Can we get the demo deck + 3 screenshots from product to illustrate the flow?
oliver: I’ll produce the 60s demo clip if we get a script and staging creds. Also need a short list of endpoints to show during demo (auth, sample request, response).
rachel: For the benchmark narrative, recommend we focus on latency and cost per 1k tokens vs baseline — one chart and one customer story. I can draft the talking points.
leo: On inbound routing — plan to tag partner leads with campaign "CLDLM-Launch-<date>" and default MQLs to SDR pool B. For partner-sourced leads, add lead_source=partner_cloudloom in SFDC and webhook to our Mktg webhook endpoint.
maria: @jasper @sara can we do asset deadlines: hero banner + logo variants by Mon EOD, demo script by Wed, blog draft by Thu, webinar slides by next Mon?
jasper: yes to logos and banner, I'll push assets today to drive. I’ll ping partner for video footage but if they don't provide we use screen capture.
sara: For the blog, suggested sections: 1) why CloudLoom + Redwood pairing matters, 2) integration walkthrough (code snippet), 3) performance & cost benchmarks, 4) CTA to marketplace listing and webinar signup.
oliver: sample code snippet for blog — use minimal curl example. I'll paste a template:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2","input":"summarize logs"}'
```
leo: Routing snippet for ops (to share with eng infra):
```
POST /webhooks/mktg
payload: {"lead_email":"...","campaign":"CLDLM-Launch-2026-04-08","partner":"cloudloom"}
```
jasper: Partner wants a co-host on the webinar — can we have a short intro + 10-min demo + fireside Q&A. Suggest 45 min total.
maria: Sounds good. Sara/Oliver, can you own moderator + demo flow? Leo, plan demand gen: paid social + partner newsletter + platform listing pin. Budget ask: $3.5k for ads.
sara: I can moderate the panel and collect audience Qs. Will draft slides and a script for Oliver's demo.
oliver: demo flow noted. Need a test tenant and API key by Fri morning.
rachel: Benchmarks — I’ll get run results by Thu and make one slide. Also will write the short customer quote placeholder (can swap to partner quote later).
leo: I'll set up the SFDC campaign and the webhook mapping. Also will create a dedicated landing page (UTM tags: utm_source=cloudloom&utm_campaign=CLDLM-Launch-2026-04-08).
maria: Action items summary: jasper=partner assets & hero; oliver=demo video + creds; sara=blog + webinar slides + moderation; rachel=benchmarks slide; leo=inbound routing + landing page + campaign. Deadline checkpoint next Tue morning 10am PT. :checkered_flag:
jasper: noted, I'll send partner comms now.
sara: putting draft outline into #marketing-drafts (will ping when ready).
leo: starting SFDC campaign now and will share webhook spec in this thread.
maria: thanks everyone — cc-ing product for any last-minute API changes. If anything blocks, call it out here. :raised_hands:
